title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Counted Withdrawals Past the Free Allowance
content:
Within a statement cycle of a Savings & Money Market Accounts product, only some withdrawals count against the tier's Free Allowance. This page sets out how the Counted Withdrawals belonging to a cycle are tallied, and how many of them lie past the Free Allowance and so each call for an excess withdrawal fee of their own.

## Rule

**Tally by channel.** A withdrawal belonging to the cycle is a Counted Withdrawal when it went through a channel the account's tier lists as one that counts. Each of these channels adds to the tally only where the tier lists it: ACH debits, outgoing domestic wires, money market checks, telephone banking transfers, online banking transfers and mobile app transfers.

**Overdraft protection transfers.** Where the tier says overdraft protection transfers count, each overdraft protection transfer belonging to the cycle joins the tally, whichever of the customer's checking accounts it protected.

**Never in the tally.** Branch cash, ATM cash and internal transfers.

**Past the Free Allowance.** The Counted Withdrawals in excess of the tier's Free Allowance are the ones that each call for an excess withdrawal fee of their own. Where the tally does not exceed the Free Allowance there are none, and a tier whose Free Allowance is unlimited has none however large the tally.

**Posting order.** Counted Withdrawals are ranked by the order in which they posted. The records keep no order inside a single day, so the policy is applied only when every Counted Withdrawal of the cycle has a posting date of its own, not shared with another Counted Withdrawal; their order then follows from the dates alone. If any two share a date, the policy squares nothing.

## Worked tally (hypothetical cycle on a tier with a Free Allowance of 6 that lists all six channels and counts overdraft transfers)

| Channel | Withdrawals in the cycle | In the tally |
|---|---|---|
| Online banking transfer | 3 | 3 |
| Telephone banking transfer | 2 | 2 |
| ACH debit | 2 | 2 |
| Overdraft protection transfer | 2 | 2 |
| ATM cash | 4 | 0 |
| Internal transfer | 1 | 0 |

Tally: 9. Past the Free Allowance of 6: the 7th, 8th and 9th Counted Withdrawals in posting order, three in all.

On an otherwise identical tier that did not count overdraft transfers, the tally would be 7 and a single withdrawal would lie past the Free Allowance.
